report_identity.report_title: Orange Sky Golden Harvest Entertainment (Holdings) Limited Annual Report 2023

business_overview.one_sentence: The group is an integrated film entertainment operator focused on cinema exhibition, film and TV programme production, film distribution, advertising and related services in Hong Kong, Singapore, Taiwan and Mainland China.

segments.business_substance: Hong Kong exhibition, distribution and corporate segment revenue; segment loss after tax was HK$24.088 million.
segments.source: Annual report 2023 note 4, segment reporting, PDF pp.125-126 / text lines 6670-6815

segments.business_substance: Singapore segment revenue, mainly cinema exhibition; segment profit after tax was HK$48.948 million.
segments.source: Annual report 2023 note 4, segment reporting, PDF pp.125-126 / text lines 6670-6815

segments.business_substance: Taiwan reportable segment revenue from a joint venture, removed in consolidation; share of profit from the joint venture was HK$2.315 million.
segments.source: Annual report 2023 note 4 and consolidated income statement, PDF pp.101,125-126 / text lines 5420-5504,6670-6815

business_overview.revenue_model: Cinema ticket receipts, concessions, film and TV rights distribution, theatre/stage operations, promotion and advertising services, agency services and related entertainment services.
business_notes: Film exhibition accounted for 96% of total segment revenue in 2023.

The group operated 43 cinemas and 353 screens at 31 December 2023 across Hong Kong, Singapore and Taiwan per portfolio table; note 4 segment table reports exhibition revenue including Taiwan joint venture before consolidation adjustment.
The first 360 Stage in Suzhou opened in the second half of 2023.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: 2023 operating cash flow was positive at HK$145.737 million, but parent net profit remained a HK$90.398 million loss, the group had material going-concern uncertainty, capital purchases of PPE and intangible assets totalled HK$116.851 million, and lease cash outflow was HK$125.205 million. A sustainable distributable cash profit denominator cannot be established from the 2023 facts.

evidence.value: Material uncertainty related to going concern: loss HK$90.401m, net current liabilities HK$284.953m, current bank loans HK$104.306m, cash and pledged deposits HK$160.280m.
evidence.source: Annual report 2023 independent auditor's report, PDF p.94 / text lines 4890-5050
evidence.note: Key constraint for detachable cash and profit denominator.

evidence.source: Annual report 2023 note 19(a), PDF p.143 / text lines 7758-7788
Annual report 2023 note 20(a), PDF p.146 / text lines 7913-7970

gaps: The annual report does not split deposits and cash by parent company versus every subsidiary for detachable-cash ownership analysis.
The annual report does not disclose a precise management estimate of necessary operating cash; owner-earnback analysis uses a conservative estimate.

Only 2023 and 2022 cash flow statement amounts are directly present in this annual report; 2021 profit is available in the five-year summary but 2021 operating cash flow and capex were not re-extracted for this run.
